title: Unit Event — Same Dreams, Same Colors — Episode7 I Can Do It Because I'm Me

meta.Episode: Episode7 — I Can Do It Because I'm Me
meta.Event Outline: Kohane and the rest of VBS continue practicing in pursuit of greater growth. However, Toya finds himself struggling to understand the vision that his teammates have for a song due to his lack of life experience. That's when Luka offers some advice!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: So this is what a forest is like...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: How is it seeing the real thing?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I think I have a better idea of what Azusawa meant by “clarity”.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Hearing all the birds chirping, the babbling brook and the wind as it breezes by...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, if I sing that one section with this in mind...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh wow...!
That's exactly what I was talking about, Aoyagi!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, don't just leave us behind.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Still, this is really nice.
All the leaves and grass are still very green despite being winter.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
That's true.
By the way, this one here's edible...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, these are called “sunroots”. They're pretty good too. You can cook them by boiling or frying them up.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
That's so interesting...!
You're like a walking encyclopedia, An.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It's not gonna make us sick or anything, right?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
They're edible. Honest!
Oh, I think I see some more over there. Why don't we pick a few while we're here?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That's great, but are you sure we can get through all of these?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
We'll be fine!
Between the four of us and our campfire, this should be just enough.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Anyway, let's start heading back.
Let's see... We came from that way, right?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, you don't have to make wild guesses. We have the GPS on our phones to... Hm?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Seriously?
I had a signal just a second ago.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: M-Me too! It wasn't strong, but it definitely seemed like we were still in range. What happened...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh no! The GPS stopped working...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I have no way of confirming this, but I've heard before that the weather can affect how cellular signals behave.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, you might be right!
Everything's starting to fog or mist up!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Just calm down.
Panicking is the worst thing we can do right now.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: First, we need to figure out where we are...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Oh, I have a pocket map...!
I made sure to pack one just in case.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But this may not be enough to tell us where we are...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We may be able to figure out where and in which direction our campsite is, but I apologize for not bringing a compass. For that, I apologize...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: No, having a map should help us out a lot!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Based on what I've read, you're supposed to retrace your steps by looking for trail markers or anything that seems familiar... What do you think, Akito?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Right... We might be able to find somewhere that looks familiar.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, let's head back a little and see if anything jogs our memories.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh no... It's starting to get really dark...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
This is bad...
We won't be able to see anything once it's pitch black.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We'll be completely lost at that point.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Does this mean we have to sleep outside...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: The cold's gonna really get us if we do. We may be wearing cold-weather gear, but getting through the night won't be easy.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
A fire would help...
But I think we left the matches back at our site.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah... Also, this fog is going to make it hard to find any dry branches.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <I believe everyone possesses some sort of “unique talent”.>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Whoa... The whole sky's lit up.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
If only we hadn't gotten lost...
We would've been able to enjoy them more...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
But we don't have a choice right now.
Let's just keep trying whatever we can, Kohane.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I don't see it... How can that be?)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Oh, right, it's winter and the trees must be in the way... That means I just have to...!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
T-Toya, what's gotten into you?!
Why are you climbing that tree?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Sorry, I just need to check on something!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (On top of that, I can't get a good footing. There's so much dew from that mist...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Climbing a tree is harder than I expected...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I've done so little with my life...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(But that doesn't matter right now!
I just need to focus on climbing!)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I should be able to see it now...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Draw two lines through those five stars, bisect those by drawing a line through the star in the middle, stretch it out to five times its length and...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: There it is! The north star!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, he's right...!
If we know where the north star is, we should be able to find our way back!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: If we apply this information to our map, we should be able to find our campsite.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Th-Thank goodness...!
Thank you so much, Toya!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
That was pretty cool...
Nice one, Toya.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
But one question...
Is it okay for you to be up that high?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wh-What did you do that for, Akito...?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh? Why are you blaming me?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I... I should be fine...
I managed to climb up... So I should be able to get back down... Right...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Get it together, Toya!
We're all heading back together!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'll be fine... I... I can get down...
